title: Differential Information Distribution: A Bayesian Perspective on Direct Preference Optimization

live_model.evidence: App. J.2: "We select the best checkpoint by absolute win-rate on Arena-Hard-v0.1 using gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 as the judge."

prompt.note: Standard Arena-Hard judge prompt is not reproduced in the paper.

claim.metric: none for the live id (used only for interim checkpoint selection, not the reported Arena-Hard/WildBench numbers)

data.source: Magpie-G27 (HuggingFace), Arena-Hard-v0.1, WildBench-v2, lm-evaluation-harness QA benchmarks

notes: gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 judges only intermediate checkpoint selection (Arena-Hard-v0.1 win-rate); the headline Table 1 Arena-Hard number is judged by gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 and WildBench-v2 by gpt-4o-2024-08-06, neither a tracked still-callable id. Primarily a theoretical DPO paper; QA benchmarks (PIQA, MMLU, GSM8K, etc.) use lm-evaluation-harness with no LLM judge at all.
